name: testmate-ai
description: TestMate AI: Test Smarter. Build Reliable AI.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run smoke
